rationale: VAD is a reusable audio/STT preprocessing concern and must remain provider-neutral.
Silero VAD is a strong local reference provider with ONNX artifacts and a permissive MIT license.
FA3 hardware portability forbids binding the provider to remembered current-host CPU/GPU identities.
Portable CPU execution is required, accelerator execution is optional and only valid with Host Resource Broker and backend compatibility receipts.
ONNX is the primary interchange path when supported; PyTorch/JIT remains non-default compatibility/reference execution.
Runtime download and torch.hub acquisition are forbidden for production execution.
